acceptance: Red-first: with a fake gh whose head moves on the second read, the verb reports the new head and exits 0.
A head that never moves is still a refusal naming the bound.
100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: After the update request, wait for the head to change (a bounded wait, for example 60 seconds, read through the gh CLI) and report 'updated to <sha>; CI runs on the new head' with exit 0. Report a refusal only when the head does not move within the bound.

source: console 2026-11-03/04: every --update-branch call today (#1273 twice, #1274, #1280 three times) printed 'refused: head is still <sha> after update-branch', and seconds later the PR head had moved
summary: evolve pr merge --update-branch reads the PR head right after GitHub accepts the update request. GitHub applies the update asynchronously, so the verb reports a refusal with exit 3 although the update succeeded. The operator then has to check the head by hand.
title: evolve pr merge --update-branch waits for the new head before it reports a refusal
